guard: the real user-auth history CLI uses its lifecycle-pinned channel grant without a human delivery ACL mirror and keeps DM and sequence refusals
why: A real IdP, exchange, user-auth broker, auth service, delivery daemon and manager create the human cli bearer. The real CLI sends and reads its own message without a delivery ACL row. An old mediator route is a named native red. Commands build all compiled dependencies and rebuild after restoration. No history page or provider response is stubbed.

mutations.name: a native human is sent back to the absent delivery ACL mirror
mutations.expectRed: native user-auth history reads the sent channel message with no stream sequence
mutations.cell: native user-auth history reads the sent channel message with no stream sequence

mutations.name: native history drops the authenticated lifecycle coordinate
mutations.expectRed: native user-auth history reads the sent channel message with no stream sequence
mutations.cell: native user-auth history reads the sent channel message with no stream sequence

mutations.name: native user-auth DM history is not refused
mutations.find:
if (user && req.dms)
    throw new CommandFailure("refused", "PERMISSION_DENIED", "DM history is readable only with the space signer's audit credential; a user-auth identity holds no DM read grant", { target: req.target });
mutations.expectRed: native user-auth history refuses DMs without an audit credential
mutations.cell: native user-auth history refuses DMs without an audit credential

mutations.name: native user-auth sequence history is not refused
mutations.find:
if (user && req.since?.kind === "seq")
    throw new CommandFailure("refused", "UNSUPPORTED", "stream-sequence cursors are not supported for user-auth history; give --since a time", { target: req.target });
mutations.expectRed: native user-auth history refuses a stream-sequence read as unsupported
mutations.cell: native user-auth history refuses a stream-sequence read as unsupported

mutations.name: a connected history read failure loses its known outcome and target
mutations.expectRed: a busy native history read reports a known failed read, not an unknown operation
mutations.cell: a busy native history read reports a known failed read, not an unknown operation
